verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a public REST Search API for searching, configuring, and managing indices and records, including header-based authentication and retry guidance. Official clients cover nine languages, are SLA-backed, and the CLI wraps the same APIs for scripts and CI. A community user reports the API stayed stable with zero maintenance. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is little independent hands-on corroboration beyond API stability.
